title: Walking Man
text: “Walking man: se hace camino al andar” makes reference to time passing by. It’s a tribute to the cinema technology. A man walking in an eternal loop based in 12 images (12 months) that compose a digital personage walking in a zoetrope animated way.

Coded for the [Medialab-Prado](http://medialab-prado.es/)‘s digital facade, 15 meters wide, as a generative sketch based on Processing.js and showcased as part of [AfterArco](http://programalaplaza.medialab-prado.es/static/videos.html) activities program.
